g.text: J1 is a logical module connector: 1=module supply, 2=GND, 3=DO. The supply pin is intentionally unconnected because slot sensor breakouts differ in supply range and circuitry. Connect it only after checking the exact module documentation.

g.desc: J1 is a logical module connector: 1=module supply, 2=GND, 3=DO. The supply pin is intentionally unconnected because slot sensor breakouts differ in supply range and circuitry. Connect it only after checking the exact module documentation.

g.text: The Uno input uses its internal pull-up. This diagram assumes an open-collector, active-low digital output; confirm the actual sensor output type and polarity. Bare optical parts need their own current limiting and signal conditioning. KiCad checks validate only this pin map.
